title: Anyone ever play the video game 'Dead Rising'? When I do, it kind of feels like Mallworld to me.
content: So I've noticed that when I've played the game Dead Rising, I feel like like I'm wondering around mallworld. You're basically a guy trying to escape from a mall filled with zombies and getting the truth out to the world about what has happened. the mall is huge. There's tunnels behind the store, underground parking garage. there are stores that you'll never see in a mall. You run into strangers that want to kill you. You run into people you save. Some of the later games, which take place elsewhere, bring in the same mall feeling and include casinos, waterparks, amusement parks and so forth. the first game includes a section with a rollercoaster. There's a theater inhabited by a crazy cult. a huge park in the center of the mall with a clock tower. a tunnel is discovered hidden in this tower towards the end of the game. a grocery store. I think the last game that came out takes place within a mall, during Christmas, and the farmlands around it. When I've played the game I get the same vibes. Loneliness, confusion, being curious and exploring. there are no disgusting restrooms. anyone else played the games and had the same vibes from it?
